run_form_composer_task: run the form composer demo task locally using the inhouse provider and default config
build_form_composer_simple: build a simple form composer React app with optional force rebuild and post install script
launch_task_run: launch a Mephisto task run using the operator and mephisto configuration
wait_for_runs_then_shutdown: wait for all task runs to complete then shut down the operator with periodic logging
task_script_decorator: wrap a main function with the task_script decorator to create a runnable CLI task with a default config
